When it is noon on Christmas Day in London, it is 11pm in Sydney. What date is it in Sydney?
why: Sydney is 11 hours ahead in December, so noon on the 25th in London is 11pm on the 25th there.

text: A kangaroo covers 8 metres in each hop. What is the fewest hops it needs to travel at least 100 metres?
why: 12 hops cover only 96 metres, so it needs a 13th: 13 × 8 = 104 metres.

text: Sydney is 10 hours ahead of London. A 22-hour flight leaves London at 9pm on Monday. When does it land, in Sydney time?
why: 9pm Monday in London is 7am Tuesday in Sydney, and 22 hours later is 5am Wednesday.
